meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

copy.tagline: 让智能助手具备部署网站的能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望智能助手能自动把网站发布上线
copy.tagline_en: Enable your assistant to deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to deploy websites for you

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能把 Web 应用直接部署到 Vercel：它会自动配置 Vercel 凭据，并使用 vercel 命令行完成发布、查看部署列表和检查登录状态。
howto.when: 当用户想让 agent 把 Web 应用部署到 Vercel 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境。
say.note: Claude 会运行 vercel deploy 并发布。

say.text: 看看我最近有哪些 Vercel 部署。
say.note: Claude 会运行 vercel ls 列出部署。

say.text: 检查一下 Vercel 的登录状态。
say.note: Claude 会运行 vercel whoami 确认认证。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can deploy web applications to Vercel directly. It automatically configures Vercel credentials and uses the Vercel CLI to run deployments, list deployments, and check authentication.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

say_en.text: Deploy my current project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Claude runs vercel deploy to publish.

say_en.text: Show me my recent Vercel deployments.
say_en.note: Claude runs vercel ls to list them.
Claude runs vercel whoami to verify auth.
